adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a real authorization defect and email/dedupe correctness issues. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `isTeamAdmin(...) && isTeamOwner(...)`, which requires the user to be BOTH admin and owner, likely unintentionally denying access to legitimate admins or owners (permission matrix bug). The guest filtering is also case-sensitive and inconsistent: blacklist entries are lowercased but `guest` is not (`blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`), and existing-attendee filtering uses `guest === attendee.email` with no normalization. Additionally, `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` passes the raw input list (not `uniqueGuests`), so attempting to add an already-existing attendee email will cause `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` to be true and resend `AttendeeScheduledEmail` to that existing attendee. These are concrete, diff-grounded behavior bugs; the “no tests” point is secondary.
